description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's merge-recursive functionality, specifically focusing on rename detection and handling merge conflicts involving renames under various thresholds and configurations.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Sets up expected stages for a given file after simulated rename and delete operations.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Checks if renames are detected between old and new files.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Checks if renames are not detected between old and new files.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Verifies the total number of staged files.

methods.name: check_threshold_0
methods.description: Verifies detection with a low similarity threshold for renames.

methods.name: check_threshold_1
methods.description: Verifies detection with a medium similarity threshold for renames.

methods.name: check_threshold_2
methods.description: Verifies detection with a high similarity threshold for renames.

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Verifies detection only of exact renames (100% similarity).

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Verifies that no renames are detected.
